source.instrument: Copper Mountain S5065 VNA, 9 kHz - 2 GHz, 50 ohm (Touchstone headers)
source.setup: port 1 = BNG drive channel A or B, port 2 = detector signal output; ChanAB = channel A to channel B

caveats: Measured. The channel-to-detector traces approach the VNA noise floor at high frequency; treat small differences between configurations cautiously.

Choke count and star ground are read from the filename suffixes, the only record of each configuration. What the thesis concludes about grounding and chokes is still being checked against these traces, so this page draws no conclusion of its own.
Header dates are quoted as written (e.g. 07/10/2021); day-first versus month-first is not stated in the files.
The inter-electrode capacitance comes from a weak-coupling series-C fit over 0.3 - 5 MHz, |S21| = 2 w Cm Z0, and is an upper bound on the bare plate-to-plate value.
